segments.text: Is remote work a double-edged sword? Undoubtedly.
segments.englishExplanation: Asking if working remotely has both advantages and disadvantages, followed by an emphatic affirmation.
segments.turkishExplanation: Uzaktan çalışma iki ucu keskin bir kılıç mı? Kesinlikle.

segments.text: It boosts autonomy, yet it blurs the boundary between work and rest.
segments.englishExplanation: Explaining that while it increases personal freedom, it also makes it harder to separate work time from personal rest.
segments.turkishExplanation: Özerkliği artırıyor ama işle dinlenme arasındaki çizgiyi belirsizleştiriyor.

segments.text: So the benefits come at a hidden cost?
segments.englishExplanation: Asking to confirm whether the advantages of remote work come with an unseen negative side effect.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yani getirileri gizli bir bedelle mi geliyor?

segments.text: Precisely, and companies rarely account for that burnout.
segments.englishExplanation: Agreeing completely and noting that employers rarely consider or factor in the resulting exhaustion.
segments.turkishExplanation: Aynen öyle ve şirketler bu tükenmişliği nadiren hesaba katıyor.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: An idiom used to describe something that has both beneficial and harmful aspects at the same time.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Hem avantajları hem de dezavantajları veya tehlikeleri olan bir durumu ifade eden 'iki ucu keskin bıçak/kılıç' deyimi.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Technological advancement can be a double-edged sword.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Teknolojik ilerleme iki ucu keskin bir kılıç olabilir.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: A phrasal verb meaning to consider, factor in, or take something into account when making plans or evaluations.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir durumu planlama yaparken veya karar verirken dikkate almak, hesaba katmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Did you account for unexpected travel expenses?
learningPoints.exampleTr: Beklenmedik seyahat masraflarını hesaba kattın mı?

quiz.question: In the context of segment 2, what does it mean that remote work 'blurs the boundary between work and rest'?

options.text: It makes it difficult to clearly separate working hours from personal downtime.
It requires employees to physically move their desks outside their living space.
It completely removes the obligation to complete daily professional duties.
It strictly enforces fixed schedules so that employees cannot take breaks.
